title: JSDoc as a checklist

blocks.md:
## `@param` / `@returns` are a contract you can read

This is not TypeScript-as-product. One lesson: write the tags so a later you (or a TS pack) can check them.

`/** @param {string[]} dirs @returns {number} */`

Print `walkLength` of two dirs (`2`).

choices.md: Are enforced by Node at runtime
Document the contract; tools may check them later

description: A short comment can be a checklist of what a function owes.
